read.says: Nov 23 close: SPY +4.73%, QQQ +7.00%, DIA +3.04%, IWM +3.56%; S&P 500 at 7,237.17, its 33rd biggest gain since 1957; Nvidia +31.48%, CrowdStrike -8.92%, Zscaler +17.67% (3.3% below the deal's value), Capricor -74.70%. After hours: HPE -6.90% on revenue +50% to $14.5 billion and a raised fiscal 2027 outlook; Fluence +17.37% on record orders of $3.5 billion; Agilent +6.79%; Semtech -4.61%; Kymera started a proposed $1.5 billion public offering of new shares at 4:45 p.m. ET (+2.74%).

singles.beneath: In the morning's case file the mosaic gave Kymera a 7.4% chance of a sale of new shares within 20 sessions, against 0.9% for the usual stock (5 sales opened in three years, a registration on file); it came the same day. One case says nothing about calibration, which P1a tested. $1.5 billion is about a tenth of its market value after the jump (about $15 billion: the morning case file's $11.5 billion x 1.304; inferred). The desk's call 63a7bc55 (15% either way from $124.06 by Nov 27): Monday's close, about $150.4 ($115.31 x 1.304), is about 21% above $124.06; it is judged at the Nov 27 close.
